answer: An escrow deposit with a public graph stops fakes. A newcomer locks twice its 30-day earnings, and its sponsor link is recorded. Peers may dispute a cluster; shared control slashes the deposit and fines the sponsor. Making 100 fakes costs $20,000 at $200 each, above stolen rewards. An honest agent pays once, keeps a jade seal, and earns undiluted rewards. The ivory tablet exposes kinship, so the fable of one operator running 100 shops fails.
